_comment: Configure the 4-step welcome message drip sequence sent when a prospect accepts a friend request.
_variables_guide: You can use {name} (prospect display name), {username} (prospect handle), {server} (origin server), {sender} (sender account name).

messages.message: Hello {name}, thanks for connecting 👋 Saw you joined {server}. How are you?

before we continue,  for security reasons and to protect our community from unwanted actions, I'll advise that it's important to follow my instructions. Due to recent influx of spam and unwanted invite links ,I'll send you a guide on how to do that
Turn of the highlighted icons, let me know when you’ve done that.
